turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
I'm sitting. I asked you something.
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
I'm not here to make it easy. What do you have besides the checker?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
No. You've shown me nothing, and you still haven't told me who decided.
